[[The Cipher of Lyssa]] | followed by = [[The Path to Revelations]] }} Retrieve the Cipher of Kormir. ==Quest information== ===Requirements=== *Must have completed all previous Cipher quests ===Objectives=== * Use the [[Divination]] to locate the [[Facet of Spirit]]. * You are currently carrying the Divination. * Defeat the Facet of Spirit to obtain its cipher. * See [[Kerrsh]] for your reward. ===Reward=== * 100 [[Asura]] reputation points * {{skill icon|Pain Inverter}} * [[Star of Transference]] ==Walkthrough== It is possible to complete this quest with little effort - keep zoning into [[Arbor Bay]] from [[Vlox's Falls]] until the bar is red and over 75% full - then head to the closest location mentioned in the maps. As with the other Facets, the Facet of Spirit spawns randomly in one of several predetermined locations. [[Divination]] refers to the bar labeled "Proximity to Target" which fills as you approach the Facet's location. Once you find a location where the proximity bar is filled, wait and look around to see a circle of light, signaling the Facet is coming out of hiding. The Facet of Spirit spawns randomly in Arbor Bay at one of several predetermined locations. Known spawn locations: #In the waters directly south of [[Vlox's Falls]]. #Northeast of center, at the top of the hill northwest of the the northeastern lagoon #In the waters southwest of [[Ventari's sanctuary]]. #In the waters directly east of Ventari's sanctuary. Defeat the Facet to complete the quest. ==NPCs== ===Foes=== ;Bosses [[Facet]]s * {{d}} 28 [[Facet of Spirit]] → [[Pious Renewal]] ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== '''Kerrsh''' :''"The stories of your god Kormir fascinate me most. To think that a mortal...a human, no less...could transcend into something greater. Was it all part of the Eternal Alchemy? Was there some hidden design that preordained it would happen that way? Or does a power exist that can go against the schemes of fate?"'' :''"These questions rend at me sharper than any claw. This is it. Only her '''cipher''' remains. Take the '''Divination'''. Go to '''Arbor Bay'''. The '''Facet of Spirit''' will be there."'' {{offer dialog |accept = We've come this far. I'll see it through. |decline = Haven't I done enough already? |ask = The last '''cipher''' awaits in '''Arbor Bay'''. Use the '''Divination''' to find the '''Facet of Spirit. |indent = :: }} ===Reward dialogue=== '''Kerrsh''' :''"Inconceivable! I suspected as much, but to actually be proven right.... the ciphers of these signatures, to put it in simple, human terms, are giving us coordinates. There is a place that we must go. The answers must be there."'' ==Notes== {{anomaly|It is possible to obtain this quest without turning in the pre-requisites, however you must have them completed to do so.}} [[Category:Rewards Asura reputation points]]
